description: Search and read approved Notion workspaces and Confluence spaces as live business knowledge, with optional relevant-page recall before a turn.
skill_summary: How to search connected Notion and Confluence sources, open authoritative pages, respect approved roots/spaces, and cite workspace knowledge without confusing it with the native Wiki.
note: This is for existing third-party knowledge workspaces. Wiki Control remains WebAgent's native shared Wiki.

settings.label: Automatic Workspace Recall
settings.hint: Search configured workspaces before substantive turns and inject a few cited page excerpts.

settings.label: Maximum Search Results
settings.hint: Hard cap for workspace search results returned to the agent.

settings.label: Recall Excerpt Characters
settings.hint: Maximum characters injected from each automatically recalled page.
